item.title: Despite ceasefire, Israeli strikes still kill in Gaza and the West Bank
item.description: Despite a ceasefire that has been in place since October 2025, violence continues in Gaza. On August 23, Israeli strikes left several people dead in the enclave, and a young boy was killed by the Israeli military in the West Bank, according to local authorities. Since the announcement of the truce, more than 1,280 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza, while Israel has reported the launch of drones, balloons and kites towards its territory.

item.title: Israel warns of 'forceful' response to kites flown from Gaza
item.description: Hamas says the kites found in Israeli border communities in recent days were launched by children in Gaza.

item.title: Middle East live: Iran warns of a harsh response to anticipated US sanctions
item.description: President Donald Trump on Monday said Iran is "completely collapsing" in a message posted on social media just hours before the US was set to announce details of new sanctions against Tehran. Iran’s foreign ministry has warned that Tehran will respond harshly to expanded sanctions, including measures against countries cooperating with Washington. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

item.title: Israeli strikes kill three, including child, in Gaza Strip
item.description: Israeli strikes in the central Gaza Strip killed three people, including a child, on Sunday, according to rescuers. The strikes came two days after a Palestinian teenager was killed by Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank following a rock-throwing incident.

item.title: Iran discovers major new gas reserves amid war-hit energy sector
item.description: Iran on Sunday said it had discovered more than 200 billion cubic metres of natural gas in the southern Fars province, with more than 160 billion cubic metres potentially recoverable. The find comes as the country’s energy sector faces disruption after months of US-Israeli strikes on gas facilities, oil depots and transport routes.

item.title: U.S.-Canada Trade War: What to Know About Tariffs and the Negotiations
item.description: Canada suspended trade negotiations, triggering President Trump’s 50 percent tariffs on a range of Canadian goods. Mark Carney said he would retaliate “dollar for dollar.”

item.description:

item.title: שר ההגנה הישראלי שם לב לכוח נאט"ו כאשר המתיחות במזרח התיכון גוברת: "הרפתקאות מסוכנות"
item.description: שר ההגנה הישראלי, ישראל כץ, הזהיר את רג'פ טאיפ ארדואן שלא לבחון את נחישותה של ישראל לאחר התקיפה של בסיס אבו אל-דוחור בסוריה.

item.title: Hundreds of Gaza children join a mass swimming lesson to cope with trauma
item.description: In Gaza, the war has upended the lives of an entire generation of children. In an effort to help them cope with the trauma of the conflict, an NGO has launched a project in Khan Younis: a huge swimming lesson that could even set a world record. Hundreds of children have gathered on the beach to learn how to swim. Story by Charlotte Hughes.

item.title: Iran warns states joining US sanctions will be considered enemies
item.description: Iran on Saturday said that any country participating in the United States’ “economic war” against the Islamic republic would be considered “an enemy”. The warning came after President Masoud Pezeshkian said Friday the war with the US should end because the world had already accepted that Iran had won, according to Iranian state media.
